title: Jobs people do
examples: What do doctors do in the hospital?
Can you show me what a farmer does?

explain.say: Today you will learn about jobs people do.

items: Doctors help people when they are sick.
Teachers help us learn new things.

explain.say: Farmers work on farms. Farmers grow food for us.
Builders use tools to make houses and other buildings.
A doctor helps you when you are sick or hurt.
Firefighters come when there is a fire. They help keep everyone safe.
Builders help when a school needs a new classroom.

faq.q: What does a teacher do all day?
faq.a: A teacher teaches students many things every day. They help you learn your letters and numbers.
No, firefighters also help people who are stuck or need rescue. They are very brave helpers.

faq.q: Where do farmers grow their food?
faq.a: Farmers grow food on farms, which are large pieces of land. They take care of the plants and animals.
asks: Where do we get our food from?

faq.a: Builders use tools like hammers and saws to build things strong. They make sure the houses are safe for us.

faq.q: Do doctors only help with cuts and bumps?
faq.a: No. Doctors check how you feel. They help you get better when you are sick.
asks: When do you see a doctor?

facts: Doctors work in clinics or hospitals.
Farmers grow crops like wheat and corn.
Builders use materials like wood and bricks.

quiz.say: Who helps you learn to read and count at school?
quiz.why: A teacher helps children learn at school.

wrong.1: A farmer grows food on a farm.
wrong.2: A builder makes houses and buildings.

quiz.say: Who comes to put out a fire?
quiz.why: Firefighters use hoses and water to put out fires. If you see a fire, tell a grown-up.

wrong.0: A doctor helps people who are sick or hurt.

quiz.say: Who grows food like potatoes and apples?

wrong.0: A cook makes meals with food, and a farmer grows it.
wrong.2: A builder makes houses and buildings.
